analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-use-after-free in typed property assignment due to reentrancy during type verification/conversion. In zend_std_write_property(), for typed properties in the write_std_property path, code takes variable_ptr = OBJ_PROP(zobj, property_offset), then calls zend_verify_property_type() on a temp zval. That verification may coerce via __toString() (through zend_verify_scalar_type_hint -> zend_parse_arg_str_weak -> zend_std_cast_object_tostring), and user code in __toString() can mutate globals and release/destroy the target object. After returning, zend_std_write_property() still uses the stale variable_ptr and writes Z_PROP_FLAG_P(variable_ptr)=0 / assigns through zend_assign_to_variable(), causing UAF.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: PoV creates class A with typed string property and assigns an object B to it. During assignment ($a->prop = new B), type check for string invokes B::__toString(). __toString() executes `global $a; $a="";`, overwriting the only reference to A and freeing its object storage/properties. Control returns to zend_std_write_property(), which assumes previously fetched property pointer is still valid and writes through it. Trigger requires typed property assignment that performs coercion with userland callback (__toString()) that can drop the last ref to the destination object.
